## Checks

- [ ] Changed technical claims cite a primary source, with a version and date where it matters.
- [ ] Editorial changes are separate from organization or presentation changes.
- [ ] `npm --prefix website run format:check`, `run check`, `test` and `run build` pass locally.
- [ ] If the lab changed, `labs/reference/` was regenerated with the documented seed and reviewed.

See [publishing and contributing](../content/publishing.md) for the full review practice.
